Class ThreadDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.ThreadDispatch
@Internal public final class ThreadDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of thread operations (starts, sleeps, parks, monitor entries, thread-local access) and of the session hand-off between threads.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

      public void beforeThreadStart(@Nullable Thread thread, boolean poolWorker) throws Throwable
      Called before Thread.start() to apply any active chaos scenario matching the thread.
      Parameters:
      thread - the thread about to be started; may be null
      poolWorker - whether a thread pool is starting one of its workers: such a thread serves many tasks, each carrying its submitter's session, so it does not inherit the starter's
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a matching scenario's terminal action mandates it

      public boolean beforeThreadLocalGet(Object threadLocal) throws Throwable
      Called before ThreadLocal.get(); returns true to suppress the get and return null.

      public boolean beforeThreadSleep(long millis) throws Throwable
      Called before Thread.sleep(long).
